title: Hill Bolivar Christmas Caroling
seo_title: Hill Bolivar Christmas Caroling in Bolivar, MO
description: This is a Christmas caroling night where the group meets at The Hill Bolivar, in place of the normal midweek service, and heads into local neighborhoods to share Christmas songs, smiles, and fellowship. It is a chance to celebrate the season and be a blessing to the community. It takes place on December 16, 2026, with a 6:00 PM meet-up at 2103 S Springfield Ave in Bolivar, MO.
